signal: Uncountable raised a $27M Series A led by Sageview Capital and in April 2026 announced a strategic collaboration with DuPont to advance AI-ready labs.

email.body1:
Alexander, saw Uncountable's 27M dollar Series A and the new DuPont collaboration on AI-ready labs.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market R&D accounts than your team can personally cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Uncountable off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alexander, quick follow-up for Uncountable.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Uncountable needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alexander, last bit of proof for Uncountable.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Uncountable's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alexander, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right after the raise, no problem at all. Timing is everything post-Series A, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I'll tailor it to Uncountable either way.
